_readme: Checkout: Stripe payment links (Managed Payments on), from Stripe Dashboard > Payment links. Leave them empty until Stripe is set up; "live" stays false until the links are LIVE-mode links. Test on the site with ?paywall=1. manage: where customers manage or cancel (Link). supabaseUrl and supabaseAnonKey: Supabase > Project Settings > API (public by design). refundDays: the money-back window shown on the site. ownerHash: fingerprint of the creator key.
